critical_code_review_comments: Duplicate window relies on lexicographic comparison of ISO created_at strings vs cutoff isoformat(); works as long as all created_at use now_iso() (+00:00). Records with 'Z' suffix or naive timestamps would compare inconsistently - minor.
Advance guard excludes 'draft' status (fine) but a draft followed by immediate submit of identical data will create two records (draft + submitted) - acceptable/by design.
Payment Requests verified via API only (first OK, immediate identical repeat -> 409 naming REQ no, after 3-min backdate -> 200 new REQ no); ProjectRequests.jsx UI not exercised in this iteration.
